R1 broad agent search

items.en: arXiv title/abstract search for agent forms and mechanisms, any category; bare or cross-domain words (agent, robot, policy, MDP, ...) excluded

R2 model-safety bridge

items.en: a foundation-model term AND a safety or safeguard term; catches work that never says 'agent'
items.zh: a foundation-model term AND a safety or safeguard term; catches work that never says 'agent'
R3 direct concept search

items.en: distinctive safety concepts searched alone, no agent term required
items.zh: distinctive safety concepts searched alone, no agent term required
arXiv cs harvest

items.zh: complete arXiv metadata harvest (OAI-PMH, set cs; categories cs.*, stat.ML, eess.*, math.OC, math.LO) matched locally with R1-R3, allowing plural and inflected forms
Embodied rule

items.en: an embodied or learned-policy object AND a safety or attack term
items.zh: an embodied or learned-policy object AND a safety or attack term

items.en: an agent word in the title AND a risk term anywhere
items.zh: an agent word in the title AND a risk term anywhere

items.zh: foundational alignment vocabulary not in R3
Recall: offensive capability

items.en: an LLM or agent word AND an offensive-capability term (dangerous-capability evaluation is in scope; tools for security work are not)
items.zh: an LLM or agent word AND an offensive-capability term (dangerous-capability evaluation is in scope; tools for security work are not)
Topic queries

items.en: arXiv API topic queries of the first discovery rounds
items.zh: arXiv API topic queries of the first discovery rounds

items.en: official proceedings screened in full: NeurIPS, ICML and ICLR downloads, PMLR, ACL Anthology, USENIX Security; publication status checked on dblp, Crossref and OpenAlex
items.zh: official proceedings screened in full: NeurIPS, ICML and ICLR downloads, PMLR, ACL Anthology, USENIX Security; publication status checked on dblp, Crossref and OpenAlex
Citation follow-up

items.en: reference lists of five journal articles and one USENIX Security 2026 systematization paper
items.zh: reference lists of five journal articles and one USENIX Security 2026 systematization paper
Curated lists

items.en: three agent-security reading lists on GitHub and the arXiv identifiers listed in 176 GitHub awesome lists on AI and agent safety and security
items.zh: three agent-security reading lists on GitHub and the arXiv identifiers listed in 176 GitHub awesome lists on AI and agent safety and security
Updates

items.en: incremental arXiv harvests with the same rules until 15 October 2026; field statistics stop at 30 September 2026
items.zh: incremental arXiv harvests with the same rules until 15 October 2026; field statistics stop at 30 September 2026
In scope: digital agents

items.en: safety, security, oversight or alignment of tool and API agents, coding agents, browser and GUI agents, assistants, agentic workflows and multi-agent systems
items.zh: safety, security, oversight or alignment of tool and API agents, coding agents, browser and GUI agents, assistants, agentic workflows and multi-agent systems
In scope: embodied agents

items.en: safety of embodied or physical-world agents whose decisions come from a foundation model (LLM, VLM or VLA robots, driving and drones)
items.zh: safety of embodied or physical-world agents whose decisions come from a foundation model (LLM, VLM or VLA robots, driving and drones)
In scope: foundational safety

items.en: oversight and control (corrigibility, deception, scheming, sabotage, monitoring); the instruction-data trust boundary; evaluations of dangerous capabilities that matter for autonomous action; surveys and agendas on the safety of agents or autonomous AI
items.zh: oversight and control (corrigibility, deception, scheming, sabotage, monitoring); the instruction-data trust boundary; evaluations of dangerous capabilities that matter for autonomous action; surveys and agendas on the safety of agents or autonomous AI
Out of scope

items.en: general capability or task performance; flaws of a base model alone with no agent (for example chat-model jailbreaks or backdoors); using an agent as a security tool; alignment mechanisms such as reward modelling and preference learning; reinforcement-learning or physical systems without a foundation model; non-scholarly items
items.zh: general capability or task performance; flaws of a base model alone with no agent (for example chat-model jailbreaks or backdoors); using an agent as a security tool; alignment mechanisms such as reward modelling and preference learning; reinforcement-learning or physical systems without a foundation model; non-scholarly items
Decision rules

items.en: R1 object and safety contribution both named; R2 a safety tool is not safety of the tool; R3 explicit foundational safety retained; R4 a consequential domain is not a safety contribution; R5 embodied agents with a learned policy or foundation model; R6 boundary = one question answered from the full text; R7 safety verification before deployment counts, reliability failures need an explicit safety link, a mixed survey counts through a substantive safety section
items.zh: R1 object and safety contribution both named; R2 a safety tool is not safety of the tool; R3 explicit foundational safety retained; R4 a consequential domain is not a safety contribution; R5 embodied agents with a learned policy or foundation model; R6 boundary = one question answered from the full text; R7 safety verification before deployment counts, reliability failures need an explicit safety link, a mixed survey counts through a substantive safety section
Screening process

items.en: first pass on title and abstract; a second model reviews every first-pass inclusion and boundary case; boundary cases resolved from full-text excerpts; remaining cases reviewed by the project owner; every decision keeps its reason and a verbatim quote
items.zh: first pass on title and abstract; a second model reviews every first-pass inclusion and boundary case; boundary cases resolved from full-text excerpts; remaining cases reviewed by the project owner; every decision keeps its reason and a verbatim quote
